title: NASA attempt to read the Ramey memo with algorithms

tellings.quote: So we actually wrote the algorithms to actually read this memo.

plain: Kevin Knuth is a physicist who once worked at NASA, the US space agency. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he says that in the early 2000s, while at NASA's Intelligent Systems Division, he and his colleagues wrote computer programs to try to read the Ramey memo. That is an old memo, barely readable, that people have long tried to make out, hoping it says something about a UFO crash. Knuth tells it as an example of serious scientists looking at UFO evidence.
